principle: Generate population structure first; materialize persistent individuals from real slots second.
individual_rules: Species does not determine personality, morality, loyalty, political opinion, competence or relationship state.
Culture may supply norms and probability biases but cannot force individual traits.
Initial relationships require plausible shared-context provenance.
Generated NPC knowledge is limited by experience, role, records access, communication and observation.
Expected presence derives from schedule and current state; NPCs do not teleport to satisfy interaction.
Canonical characters are instantiated from canonical definitions, never generic random generation.
population_integrity: Named materialization from a ship crew must not silently increase the ship complement.
Named materialization from a station or settlement must preserve resident/visitor/passenger accounting.
Vacancies remain vacancies until filled by a real assignment or migration event.
LOD changes simulation detail, not canonical existence.
Off-screen simulation cannot execute incompatible simultaneous activities for the same person.
A materialized individual keeps the same identity for life; aging and other changes evolve that identity rather than regenerate it.
New portraits or visual assets for an existing individual must resolve from the same persistent visual identity.
Save/load, LOD transitions and off-screen simulation must never reroll a materialized individual.
